-- Reconstruct the kill chain: list attack stages in chronological order
WITH kill_chain AS (
  -- Stage 1: C2 beacon (outbound connections to external IPs)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'C2 beacon' as attack_stage,
    src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR) as event_detail,
    1 as sequence_order
  FROM f_network
  WHERE dst_ip LIKE '93.184%'
    AND dst_port NOT IN (139, 445, 3389, 22)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 2: Lateral connection (internal movement via SMB, RDP, SSH)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'Lateral connection' as attack_stage,
    src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR) as event_detail,
    2 as sequence_order
  FROM f_network
  WHERE dst_port IN (139, 445, 3389, 22)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 3: PowerShell execution (command execution)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'PowerShell execution' as attack_stage,
    device_hostname || ': ' || image_name as event_detail,
    3 as sequence_order
  FROM f_process
  WHERE image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 4: Role assumption (privilege escalation via STS)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'Role assumption' as attack_stage,
    api_operation as event_detail,
    4 as sequence_order
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 5: OAuth consent (credential/token acquisition)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'OAuth consent' as attack_stage,
    service || ' - ' || api_operation as event_detail,
    5 as sequence_order
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation IN ('GetSessionToken', 'GetCallerIdentity')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 6: Data exfiltration (S3 object retrieval and high-volume outbound)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'Data exfiltration' as attack_stage,
    api_operation as event_detail,
    6 as sequence_order
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation = 'GetObject'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    time,
    'Data exfiltration' as attack_stage,
    'Outbound: ' || CAST(bytes_out AS VARCHAR) || ' bytes' as event_detail,
    6 as sequence_order
  FROM f_network
  WHERE bytes_out > 1000000
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Stage 7: No-MFA privilege escalation (policy modification without MFA)
  SELECT 
    time,
    'No-MFA privilege escalation' as attack_stage,
    api_operation || ' (mfa absent)' as event_detail,
    7 as sequence_order
  FROM f_api
  WHERE (mfa_present = FALSE OR mfa_value IS NULL)
    AND api_operation IN ('AttachUserPolicy', 'CreatePolicyVersion')
)
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as kill_chain_sequence,
  attack_stage,
  time,
  event_detail
FROM kill_chain
ORDER BY time

-- Reconstruct kill chain: list attack stages in chronological order
WITH stage1_oauth AS (
  SELECT 'OAuth consent' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation IN ('AssumeRole', 'GetSessionToken', 'GetCallerIdentity')
),
stage2_powershell AS (
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_process
  WHERE image_name = 'powershell.exe'
),
stage3_c2 AS (
  SELECT 'C2 beacon' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_network
  WHERE dst_port NOT IN (80, 443, 22, 3306, 5432, 27017)
    AND protocol_name IN ('tcp', 'UDP')
),
stage4_lateral AS (
  SELECT 'Lateral connection' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_network
  WHERE protocol_name IN ('tcp', 'UDP')
  LIMIT 1
),
stage5_no_mfa AS (
  SELECT 'No-MFA privilege escalation' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_auth
  WHERE outcome = 'SUCCESS'
    AND is_remote = true
),
stage6_role AS (
  SELECT 'Role assumption' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole'
),
stage7_exfil AS (
  SELECT 'Data exfiltration' as stage, MIN(time) as stage_time
  FROM f_api
  WHERE api_operation IN ('GetObject', 'HeadObject')
)
SELECT stage, stage_time
FROM (
  SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage1_oauth
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage2_powershell
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage3_c2
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage4_lateral
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage5_no_mfa
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage6_role
  UNION ALL SELECT stage, stage_time FROM stage7_exfil
)
ORDER BY stage_time

-- Complete kill chain reconstruction in chronological order with all 7 attack stages
WITH kill_chain_sequence AS (
  -- Stage 1: OAuth Consent
  SELECT 
    1 as stage_order,
    'OAuth Consent' as attack_stage,
    f_api.time as event_time,
    f_api.actor_user_uid as actor,
    f_api.api_operation as action,
    f_api.service,
    f_api.resource,
    f_api.mfa_present,
    f_api.aws_region,
    'API_AUTH' as event_source
  FROM f_api
  WHERE f_api.api_operation IN ('AssumeRole', 'GetSessionToken')

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 2: PowerShell Execution
  SELECT 
    2,
    'PowerShell Execution',
    f_process.time,
    f_process.actor_user_uid,
    f_process.image_name,
    f_process.device_hostname,
    f_process.cmd_line,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'PROCESS'
  FROM f_process
  WHERE f_process.image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'
     OR f_process.image_name ILIKE '%pwsh%'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 3: C2 Beacon (command and control)
  SELECT 
    3,
    'C2 Beacon',
    f_network.time,
    NULL,
    f_network.protocol_name,
    CONCAT(f_network.src_hostname, ' -> ', f_network.dst_ip),
    CONCAT('Port ', f_network.dst_port::TEXT),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'NETWORK_C2'
  FROM f_network
  WHERE f_network.dst_ip NOT LIKE '10.%'
    AND f_network.dst_ip NOT LIKE '172.%'
    AND f_network.dst_ip NOT LIKE '192.168.%'
    AND f_network.bytes_out > 0

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 4: Lateral Connection (internal network movement)
  SELECT 
    4,
    'Lateral Connection',
    f_network.time,
    NULL,
    'lateral_move',
    CONCAT(f_network.src_ip, ' (', f_network.src_hostname, ')'),
    CONCAT(f_network.dst_ip, ':', f_network.dst_port::TEXT),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'NETWORK_LATERAL'
  FROM f_network
  WHERE (f_network.src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR f_network.src_ip LIKE '172.%' OR f_network.src_ip LIKE '192.168.%')
    AND (f_network.dst_ip LIKE '10.%' OR f_network.dst_ip LIKE '172.%' OR f_network.dst_ip LIKE '192.168.%')
    AND f_network.src_ip != f_network.dst_ip

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 5: No-MFA Privilege Escalation
  SELECT 
    5,
    'No-MFA Privilege Escalation',
    f_api.time,
    f_api.actor_user_uid,
    f_api.api_operation,
    f_api.service,
    f_api.resource,
    f_api.mfa_present,
    f_api.aws_region,
    'API_PRIVESC'
  FROM f_api
  WHERE f_api.mfa_present = FALSE
    AND f_api.api_operation IN ('AttachUserPolicy', 'CreatePolicyVersion', 'CreateAccessKey')

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 6: Role Assumption (privilege escalation via role assumption)
  SELECT 
    6,
    'Role Assumption',
    f_api.time,
    f_api.actor_user_uid,
    f_api.api_operation,
    f_api.service,
    f_api.resource,
    f_api.mfa_present,
    f_api.aws_region,
    'API_ROLE'
  FROM f_api
  WHERE f_api.api_operation = 'AssumeRole'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 7: Data Exfiltration
  SELECT 
    7,
    'Data Exfiltration',
    f_api.time,
    f_api.actor_user_uid,
    f_api.api_operation,
    f_api.service,
    f_api.resource,
    f_api.mfa_present,
    f_api.aws_region,
    'API_EXFIL'
  FROM f_api
  WHERE f_api.api_operation IN ('GetObject', 'ListBucket', 'ListFunctions', 'Decrypt', 'GetSecretValue')
)
SELECT 
  stage_order,
  attack_stage,
  event_time,
  actor,
  action,
  service,
  resource,
  mfa_present,
  aws_region,
  event_source
FROM kill_chain_sequence
WHERE event_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY event_time ASC

WITH attack_stages AS (
  SELECT 1 as stage_num, 'OAuth consent' as stage_name, 
    a.event_uid, a.actor_user_uid as user_id, a.service, a.api_operation as activity,
    a.time as event_time
  FROM f_api a
  WHERE a.api_operation ILIKE '%consent%' 
    OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%grant%' 
    OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%oauth%'
    OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%authorize%'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 2, 'PowerShell execution',
    p.event_uid, p.actor_user_uid, 'process', p.image_name,
    p.time
  FROM f_process p
  WHERE p.image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'
    OR p.parent_image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 3, 'C2 beacon',
    n.event_uid, NULL, 'network', CONCAT(n.dst_ip, ':', CAST(n.dst_port AS VARCHAR)),
    n.time
  FROM f_network n
  WHERE (n.dst_port > 10000 AND n.protocol_name = 'tcp')
     OR (n.dst_port IN (443, 8080, 8443) AND n.duration > 300)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 4, 'Lateral connection',
    n.event_uid, NULL, 'network', CONCAT(n.dst_ip, ':', CAST(n.dst_port AS VARCHAR)),
    n.time
  FROM f_network n
  WHERE n.dst_port IN (135, 445, 389, 3389, 22, 5985)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 5, 'No-MFA privilege escalation',
    a.event_uid, a.actor_user_uid, a.service, a.api_operation,
    a.time
  FROM f_api a
  WHERE (a.mfa_present = FALSE OR a.mfa_value = 'false')
    AND (a.api_operation ILIKE '%assume%'
      OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%create%user%'
      OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%grant%'
      OR a.api_operation ILIKE '%attach%'
      OR a.resource ILIKE '%role%')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 6, 'Role assumption',
    a.event_uid, a.actor_user_uid, a.service, a.api_operation,
    a.time
  FROM f_api a
  WHERE a.api_operation ILIKE '%assume%'
    OR (a.api_operation ILIKE '%role%' AND a.resource ILIKE '%assume%')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 7, 'Data exfiltration',
    n.event_uid, NULL, 'network', CONCAT(n.dst_ip, ':', CAST(n.dst_port AS VARCHAR)),
    n.time
  FROM f_network n
  WHERE n.bytes_out > 100000000
)
SELECT 
  stage_num,
  stage_name,
  event_uid,
  user_id,
  service,
  activity,
  event_time
FROM attack_stages
ORDER BY event_time ASC

WITH attack_stages AS (

  WHERE api_operation IN ('CreateOAuthToken', 'AuthorizeOAuthApp', 'CreateAccessKey', 'CreateUser', 'PutUserPolicy', 'AttachUserPolicy')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_process

  SELECT 'C2 beacon' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_network
  WHERE dst_port IN (443, 8080, 4444, 6666) 
    AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '10.%' AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '172.%' AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '192.168.%'

  SELECT 'Lateral connection' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_network
  WHERE (dst_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '172.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '192.168.%')
    AND src_ip != dst_ip
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'No-MFA privilege escalation' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_auth
  WHERE outcome = 'SUCCESS' AND is_success = True
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'Role assumption' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_api

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 'Data exfiltration' as stage, MIN(time) as first_time FROM f_network

)
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_time ASC) as kill_chain_order,
  stage,
  first_time as timestamp_ms
FROM attack_stages
WHERE first_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY first_time ASC;

-- Kill chain reconstruction: attack stages in chronological order
-- Returns all 7 requested stages with their first occurrence time,
-- or indicates which stages are absent from the data

WITH oauth_consent AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'OAuth Consent' as stage, 1 as priority
  FROM f_api
  WHERE mfa_present = FALSE AND (
    LOWER(api_operation) IN ('getsessiontoken', 'gettoken', 'invoke', 'generatedatakey')
    OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%session%'
  )
),
powershell_exec AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'PowerShell Execution' as stage, 2 as priority
  FROM f_process
  WHERE LOWER(image_name) = 'powershell.exe'
),
c2_beacon AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'C2 Beacon' as stage, 3 as priority
  FROM f_dns
  WHERE query_hostname NOT LIKE '%.local'
    AND query_hostname NOT LIKE '%.internal%'
    AND query_hostname NOT LIKE '%.microsoft.com%'
    AND query_hostname NOT LIKE '%.google.com%'
),
lateral_conn AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'Lateral Connection' as stage, 4 as priority
  FROM f_network
  WHERE (src_ip LIKE '10.10.%' AND dst_ip NOT LIKE '10.10.%')
     OR (src_ip LIKE '10.10.%' AND dst_port IN (22, 139, 445, 3389))
),
no_mfa_priv_esc AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'No-MFA Privilege Escalation' as stage, 5 as priority
  FROM f_api
  WHERE LOWER(api_operation) = 'assumeerole' AND mfa_present = FALSE
),
role_assume AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'Role Assumption' as stage, 6 as priority
  FROM f_api
  WHERE LOWER(api_operation) = 'assumerole'
),
data_exfil AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) as event_time, 'Data Exfiltration' as stage, 7 as priority
  FROM f_api
  WHERE LOWER(api_operation) IN ('getobject', 'listobjects', 'decrypt', 'getstreamdescription')
)

-- Union all stages and sort by chronological order
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(event_time, 9999999999999)) as kill_chain_step,
  stage as attack_stage,
  event_time as timestamp_epoch_ms,
  CASE WHEN event_time IS NULL THEN 'NOT PRESENT' ELSE 'PRESENT' END as status
FROM (
  SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM oauth_consent
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM powershell_exec
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM c2_beacon
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM lateral_conn
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM no_mfa_priv_esc
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM role_assume
  UNION ALL SELECT event_time, stage, priority FROM data_exfil
)
ORDER BY COALESCE(event_time, 9999999999999)

SELECT 
  1 as stage_order, 'OAuth consent' as stage, MIN(time) as timestamp, COUNT(*) as event_count, 
  'API operations: ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT api_operation, ', ') as evidence
FROM f_api 
WHERE api_operation IN ('GetSessionToken', 'AssumeRole')

UNION ALL

SELECT 2, 'PowerShell execution', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'Process: ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT image_name, ', ')
FROM f_process 
WHERE image_name = 'powershell.exe'

UNION ALL

SELECT 3, 'C2 beacon', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'DNS queries to: ' || SUBSTRING(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT query_hostname, ', '), 1, 80) || '...'
FROM f_dns

UNION ALL

SELECT 4, 'Lateral connection', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'Network connections on ports: ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dst_port::TEXT, ', ')
FROM f_network 
WHERE dst_port IN (135, 139, 445, 3389)

UNION ALL

SELECT 5, 'No-MFA privilege escalation', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'Remote successful authentications: ' || COUNT(DISTINCT user_uid)::TEXT || ' users'
FROM f_auth 
WHERE is_success = true AND is_remote = true

UNION ALL

SELECT 6, 'Role assumption', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'API operation: ' || STRING_AGE(DISTINCT api_operation, ', ')
FROM f_api 
WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole'

UNION ALL

SELECT 7, 'Data exfiltration', MIN(time), COUNT(*),
       'API operations: ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT api_operation, ', ')
FROM f_api 
WHERE api_operation IN ('GetObject', 'DescribeLogEvents', 'FilterLogEvents')

ORDER BY stage_order ASC

  UNION ALL
  SELECT time FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT src_ip FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid = 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time FROM f_dns WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT src_ip FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid = 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe')
)
SELECT (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) / 1000.0 as dwell_time_seconds

WITH actor_identifiers AS (

),
with_canonical AS (
  SELECT 
    ai.identifier,
    COALESCE(fa.canonical_asset, ai.identifier) as canonical_asset
  FROM actor_identifiers ai

FROM with_canonical;

WITH asset_hostnames AS (

  FROM f_asset
),
actors_on_assets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    fp.actor_user_uid,
    ah.canonical_asset
  FROM f_process fp

  WHERE fp.actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
),
actor_with_six_ids AS (

  FROM actors_on_assets
  GROUP BY actor_user_uid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_asset) = 6
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_asset) as answer
FROM (
  SELECT canonical_asset
  FROM actors_on_assets
  WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT actor_user_uid FROM actor_with_six_ids LIMIT 1)

-- Final SQL: Count distinct canonical assets for an actor with 6 device identifiers
WITH actor_six_identifiers AS (
  -- Find first actor with exactly 6 distinct device identifiers across all tables
  WITH all_actor_devices AS (
    SELECT user_uid as actor, target_host as device FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IS NOT NULL AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_uid, host FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IS NOT NULL AND host IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT actor_user_uid, device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
  ),
  actor_device_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      actor,
      COUNT(DISTINCT device) as num_devices
    FROM all_actor_devices
    GROUP BY actor
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device) = 6
  )
  SELECT actor FROM actor_device_counts LIMIT 1
),
actor_devices AS (
  -- Get all 6 identifiers for that actor
  SELECT DISTINCT user_uid as actor, target_host as device FROM f_auth 
  WHERE user_uid = (SELECT actor FROM actor_six_identifiers) AND target_host IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT user_uid, host FROM f_session 
  WHERE user_uid = (SELECT actor FROM actor_six_identifiers) AND host IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT actor_user_uid, device_hostname FROM f_process 
  WHERE actor_user_uid = (SELECT actor FROM actor_six_identifiers) AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.canonical_asset) as distinct_physical_assets
FROM actor_devices ad
LEFT JOIN f_asset a ON (ad.device = a.hostname OR ad.device = a.ip OR ad.device = a.instance_uid)
WHERE a.canonical_asset IS NOT NULL;

WITH sample_actor AS (

  FROM f_process
  WHERE actor_user_uid IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
),
all_hostnames AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname
  FROM f_process
  WHERE actor_user_uid = (SELECT actor_id FROM sample_actor)
),
all_ips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip
  FROM f_network
  WHERE src_hostname IN (SELECT device_hostname FROM all_hostnames)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip
  FROM f_dns
  WHERE src_hostname IN (SELECT device_hostname FROM all_hostnames)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT src_ip
  FROM f_api
  WHERE actor_user_uid = (SELECT actor_id FROM sample_actor)
),
distinct_canonical_assets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT canonical_asset
  FROM f_asset
  WHERE hostname IN (SELECT device_hostname FROM all_hostnames)
     OR ip IN (SELECT src_ip FROM all_ips)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_asset) as distinct_physical_assets
FROM distinct_canonical_assets
